args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money per FIN-212

The rounding mode did not match the documented/tested behavior.
ROUND_HALF_UP rounded 2.665 to 2.67 instead of 2.66, causing the
nightly test failure in tests/test_money.py.

args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py` rounded with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the documented behavior (and `tests/test_money.py`, per FIN-212) requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This mismatch broke the nightly build.

## Change
- Switched the rounding mode in `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

Verified: 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66.

## Testing
CI run ci-0001 on sha 08d3cd5986 passed (tests/test_money.py green).
